subject: eng
title: Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: This is not my umbrella. Mine is blue. Is this umbrella ___?
questions.explain: 句末不接名詞，表示「你的（雨傘）」要用名詞性物主代詞 yours。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: This is not my umbrella. Mine is blue. Is this umbrella ___?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: These storybooks belong to Ben and Sam. The books are ___.
questions.explain: 代替 their books（他們的書），用名詞性物主代詞 theirs。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: These storybooks belong to Ben and Sam. The books are ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: Don't eat too ___ sweets. They are bad for your teeth.
questions.explain: sweets 是可數複數名詞，表示「太多」用 too many。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Don't eat too ___ sweets. They are bad for your teeth.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: There is only a ___ orange juice left in the bottle.
questions.explain: orange juice 是不可數名詞，表示「少許」用 a little。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: There is only a ___ orange juice left in the bottle.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: Mum bought two ___ of bread and a jar of jam at the supermarket.
questions.explain: bread 的量詞是 loaf，兩條麵包用複數 loaves（two loaves of bread）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Mum bought two ___ of bread and a jar of jam at the supermarket.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: Change to a possessive pronoun: 'This is her ruler.' -> 'This ruler is ___.'
questions.explain: her + 名詞 相當於名詞性物主代詞 hers。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Change to a possessive pronoun: 'This is her ruler.' -> 'This ruler is ___.'
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4B Overview: Possessive Pronouns, Quantifiers & Partitives

questions.q: Rearrange the words to make a polite request.
items: pass me a bottle of water
questions.explain: 正確句序：Can you pass me a bottle of water?
answer: pass me a bottle of water
